policy: Hub-first discovery and associative mapping; unchanged V1.9-style downstream underwriting. Research selections are counted for opportunity-frequency diagnostics but are not Primary recommendations.

decisions.name: 华海药业
reasoning: Bloomberg surfaced the national procurement price reset; verification showed all three HuaHai submitted products won.
The 2020 interim report showed revenue +24.6%, attributable profit +72.8% and ex-item profit +102.9%, so the event had a real company earnings engine rather than a thematic-only story.
Price absorption was mixed: 60d excess versus CSI300 was already about +14.2pp, while 20d excess was about -1.8pp.
Severe procurement price cuts leave product-level margin durability insufficiently resolved for High-priority.

decisions.name: 万科A
reasoning: Bloomberg surfaced the three-red-line financing regime as a relative competitive shock, not merely a sector-negative headline.
Vanke's H1 report showed revenue +5.1%, attributable profit +5.6%, operating cash flow +155.3% and net debt ratio 27.0%, providing a credible balance-sheet advantage.
At the cutoff, 60d excess versus CSI300 was about -1.1pp and 20d excess about +3.5pp, so the relative-strength thesis was not obviously over-absorbed.
The policy-to-market-share/earnings transmission was not yet realized, and property-development margins were under pressure, so High-priority is not justified.
